notes: Deals: Honda Auto Receivables 2024-1, 2025-1 and 2026-1 Owner Trusts (prime retail loans originated by American Honda Finance Corporation, AHFC). One per window the brief asked for: pool ABS-EE filed 2024-02-07, 2025-01-29 and 2026-02-03. Each is the first deal of its year; Honda also issued 2024-2 (424B5 2024-05-16) in the 2024 window, 2025-4 (424B5 2025-11-07) in the Oct 2025 - Feb 2026 window, and 2026-2/3/4 after Feb 2026 (not used). Found with EDGAR full-text search for 424B5 filings naming 'Honda Auto Receivables' (2023-10-01 to 2026-11-15) and each trust's data.sec.gov submissions list.

Pool filings are filed under the trust's CIK by American Honda Receivables LLC (depositor, CIK 0000890975) on the day of the preliminary prospectus (424H). Each deal has three pool ABS-EE filings, one per deal size the 424H offers: 'sp', 'mp' and 'lp' in the file names. The 424B5 states one initial pool balance and receivable count, equal to the lp size in all three deals; the parsed lp row counts equal the 424B5 counts exactly (92,413; 104,073; 101,438) and the sum of reportingPeriodActualEndBalanceAmount equals the 424B5 initial pool balance to the cent ($2,159,245,264.72; $2,429,150,798.03; $2,483,131,904.21). The sp and mp files were not downloaded.
The 2026-1 sp and mp ABS-EE cover pages print the pool as '$1,727,396.412.29' and '$2,159,245.264.63' (a period in place of a comma); the 424H states $1,727,396,412.29 and $2,159,245,264.63.

Parquet values are kept as written. apr_pct and pti_pct are the file values times 100, rounded to 6 decimals to remove float noise. No element repeats inside an asset in these files (the parser would comma-join repeats such as 'subvented', as data/raw/santander does).

credit_score_type is 'Credit Bureau' for every loan and credit_score is numeric for every loan (no NaN). The file's min and max equal the 424B5 'Range of FICO scores' in each deal (418-900, 409-899, 418-900); values above 850 are on the FICO auto scale and were kept. The 424B5 says AHFC uses the customer's internal credit grade and the FICO score to set the loan's interest rate, and that the FICO figures are shown for comparison and may not have been used in the credit decision.
The file's APR range equals the 424B5 'Range of annual percentage rates' in each deal (0.69-24.08%, 0.50-25.79%, 0.90-24.29%), printed by validate.py.

Code meanings from the EDGAR ABS XML Technical Specification v3.1 schema (eis_ABS_AutoLoanAssetData.xsd, read from the copy in data/raw/ally/spec_absxml31, unzipped from the spec_url): subvented 0 No, 1 Yes - Rate Subvention, 2 Yes - Cash Rebate, 98 Yes - Other; new_used_code 1 New, 2 Used; interest_rate_type_code 1 Fixed, 2 Adjustable, 98 Other; vehicle_type_code 1 Car, 2 Truck, 3 SUV, 4 Motorcycle, 98 Other, 99 Unknown; vehicle_value_source_code 1 Invoice Price, 2 MSRP, 3 Kelly Blue Book, 98 Other; income_verification_code 1 not stated/not verified, 2 stated/not verified, 3 stated and verified below level 4, 4 level 4 verified, 5 level 5 verified; employment_verification_code 1 not stated/not verified, 2 stated/not verified, 3 stated, level 3 verified.

In these files subvented is only '0' or '1' (about 70% of loans are '1', rate subvention); new_used_code '1' (new) is about 83-84% of loans; interest_rate_type_code is '1' (fixed) for every loan; vehicle_value_source_code is '1' (invoice) exactly for new vehicles and '98' (other) exactly for used ones; vehicle_make is HONDA or ACURA only. No loan has apr_pct 0 (lowest 0.50%).

Pools are seasoned: origination months run 2017-12..2023-10 (2024-1), 2018-11..2024-10 (2025-1) and 2020-01..2025-10 (2026-1); 40.7% / 41.9% / 48.0% of loans were originated more than 12 months before the filing month (data/raw/honda/validate.py). Filter by origination_month before treating apr_pct as a current-market benchmark. No loan was originated after 2026-01.

Download method: data/raw/honda/sec_fetch.py, one request at a time with a 1-second pause and the sec.gov User-Agent approved in CLAUDE.md (read from CLAUDE.md, not copied here); every request is logged in data/raw/honda/sec_requests.log (git-ignored). Each XML's size equals EDGAR's index.json listing (329,951,704; 371,612,156; 362,209,716 bytes).
couldnt_confirm: Honda's EX-103 (Asset Related Document) files were not downloaded, so Honda's own explanations of fields (for example what vehicle_value_source_code '98' means for used vehicles, or how original_loan_amount is defined) were not read; meanings above come from the generic XSD.
Which FICO version 'Credit Bureau' scores are (the 424B5 says FICO but not the model); the 900 maximum points to an auto-industry FICO scale, not confirmed.
